title: Calligraphy L0-01 · The writing system and the family of the "dente"

blocks.text: Calligraphy L0-01 · The writing system and the family of the "dente"
⁧ا⁩ alif · ā (after fatḥa) · [aː] Sign of the ā long; at the beginning of the word brings the hamza. It's not connected to the next one.
⁧ب⁩ bāʾ · b · /b/ Sound bilabial occlusive. One point below.
⁧ت⁩ tāʾ · t · /t/ deaf dental Occlusive, not emphatic. Two points above.
⁧ث⁩ ṯāʾ · ṯ · /θ/ Deaf interdental fricative: tongue between teeth. Three points above.
⁧ن⁩ nūn · n · /n/ Alveolar nasal. One point above; isolated and final descend below the line.
nāb tusk, canine tooth ⁧نَابنَابنَاب⁩ tibn straw ⁧تِبْنتِبْنتِبْن⁩
